headline: Anthropic signs Korea safety pact; G7 hosts AI lab chiefs
body: A calmer, slightly brighter day. Anthropic opened a Seoul office and signed an agreement with Korea's science ministry covering Korean-language safety evaluations and cyber-threat sharing. Better safety testing strengthens Alignment & Control, which lifts Protector God and Gatekeeper and pushes Conquerors down. At the G7 summit in Evian, leaders met Altman, Amodei and Hassabis and agreed principles to protect minors from harmful AI content, a modest boost to Global Coordination, though data-center sustainability goals were weakened over US objections. Separately, more than 300 security leaders asked the US to reverse its ban on Claude Fable 5. Horizon Balance rose to +1.63.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.2, Self-Destruction -0.1 and Benevolent Dictator +0.1. The Anthropic-Korea MOU (Gatekeeper +0.11) and the G7 session (Gatekeeper +0.10, Self-Destruction -0.07) drove the moves.
